name: lint
description: Run ESLint and Prettier on the codebase, report violations, and auto-fix where possible. Produces a summary of lint errors, warnings, and auto-fixed files.

inputs.name: fix
inputs.description: If true, run with --fix flag to auto-fix violations. Default: false.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specific file or directory to lint. Default: src/.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Lint report: errorCount, warningCount, fixedCount, files.

failureConditions.signal: command exits with 'no eslint configuration found'
